source.algorithm: regex [^a-zA-Z0-9] replaced with '_' (strict slug: no dots, no dashes, no case-folding survive)
source.note: string_ext.rs and auth.rs are byte-identical between tag v0.5.8 and the pinned commit (git diff v0.5.8..HEAD -- these two files is empty), so this corpus is valid against the live-probed ocx 0.5.8 binary.
source.note_relaxed_slug: A SEPARATE, more permissive transform (StringExt::to_relaxed_slug / file_structure::slugify, regex [^a-zA-Z0-9._-] -> '_', preserves dots and hyphens) is used for ON-DISK PATH components (package_store, layer_store, blob_store, shim_store, index_store, patch expand_patch_path). It is NOT the 'registry_slug' WP06 needs (that one is strictly to_slug(), used only for the OCX_AUTH_* env var name). Not included in this corpus — flag if a future WP needs it.
